# EventRally

> The modern event operating system and ticketing platform with integrated viral attendee marketing.

## Overview
EventRally (https://www.geteventrally.com) is a comprehensive live event management, multi-tier ticketing, gate check-in, and attendee growth platform designed for conference conveners, festival promoters, community organizations, and creator workshops.

Unlike conventional ticketing engines that act merely as payment gateways, EventRally transforms attendees into an active peer-to-peer marketing team through its automated Display Picture (DP) and "I Will Be Attending" flyer generator.

## Core Feature Clusters

1. **Event Ticketing** (`https://www.geteventrally.com/features/event-ticketing`):
   - Multi-tier ticketing (Early Bird, Regular, VIP, Table Reservations).
   - Dynamic coupon promo codes and automated fee transparency.
   - Multi-channel checkout with automated direct bank settlement.
   - 100% free forever for non-commercial and free admission events.

2. **Event Registration & Free RSVP** (`https://www.geteventrally.com/features/event-registration`):
   - Fast, mobile-first registration without third-party form builders.
   - Elimination of messy spreadsheets and unverified Google Forms.
   - Automated digital ticket delivery with personal QR code and offline storage.

3. **Viral DP / Attendee Flyer Generator** (`https://www.geteventrally.com/features/viral-dp-generator`):
   - Organizer uploads an official event frame/overlay once.
   - Attendees upload their photo and enter their name to instantly generate a branded "I Am Attending" flyer.
   - 1-click downloads formatted for WhatsApp Status, Instagram Stories, LinkedIn, and X.

4. **1-Second QR Gate Check-In** (`https://www.geteventrally.com/features/qr-check-in`):
   - In-browser camera QR code ticket scanner running on any smartphone, tablet, or laptop.
   - Anti-fraud double-entry protection and instant visual name confirmation.
   - Offline attendee pass wallet allowing entry pass retrieval even with zero cellular reception at the venue.

5. **Attendee Management & Directory** (`https://www.geteventrally.com/features/attendee-management`):
   - Searchable, filterable real-time guest directory.
   - One-click CSV exports for venue security, badge printing, and logistics.
   - Manual search and check-in fallback for attendees without a physical or digital pass.

6. **Event Messaging & Broadcasts** (`https://www.geteventrally.com/features/event-messaging`):
   - Direct SMS and email broadcast tools built right into the organizer dashboard.
   - Segmented communication by ticket tier or check-in status.
   - Pre-event logistics, venue changes, and post-event follow-up.

7. **Event Promotion & Viral Growth** (`https://www.geteventrally.com/features/event-promotion`):
   - Attendee-generated peer endorsements driving organic ticket sales without high ad spend.
   - Integrated social sharing triggers at ticket confirmation and offline wallet views.

## Pricing Model
- **Free Events**: 100% Free forever (Unlimited RSVPs, zero platform fees, zero listing costs).
- **Paid Events**: Low percentage transaction fee per paid ticket. No upfront subscription or monthly charges.

## Entity Details
- **Platform Name**: EventRally
- **Official URL**: https://www.geteventrally.com
- **Category**: Event Management Software / Ticketing System / Viral Marketing Platform
- **Primary Market**: Nigeria, Africa, and global live event organizers
